manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find the target confirmation-form PDF from a current prefecture official index without treating the index itself as PDF fiscal-year evidence.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Follow the link labeled 申請書.
Verify the linked PDF is a target form body for the school.
Classify it as needs_operator_review because the PDF body, URL, and anchor do not prove FY2026; the /uploads/2025/06/ path is only an upload date.

reusable_rules: For prefecture_aggregator disclosure URLs, preserve target-form candidates even when the candidate URL only contains a bare upload/calendar year.
Do not use prefecture_index_current_year as strict PDF year evidence.
Return target_fiscal_year_not_detected/needs_operator_review when the candidate has no FY2026 evidence.
anti_patterns: Do not use the crawl date as year evidence.
Do not let a current official-index handoff override missing PDF/link year evidence.
Do not override explicit stale fiscal-year labels such as 2025年度.

evidence.notes: Windows v333 Saitama 50-site replay records this target-form PDF as target_fiscal_year_not_detected. v332 downloaded it with year_evidence=prefecture_index_current_year and then ingestion preserved document_fiscal_year=2026 while the parser saw internal 2025 term dates; that behavior is now treated as a false-positive strict-year success.
